Note that all of the terms have a common factor of $4{z}^{6}.$ To simplify the computation, we can factor out the $4{z}^{6},$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}^{2}{z}^{6}+8x{z}^{6}-60{z}^{6}=(4{z}^{6})\cdot {x}^{2}+(4{z}^{6})\cdot 2x-(4{z}^{6})\cdot 15=4{z}^{6}({x}^{2}+2x-15).\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we factor the polynomial ${x}^{2}+2x-15,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{z}^{6}({x}^{2}+2x-15) & = \\ 4{z}^{6}(({x}^{2}+5x)+(-3x-15)) & = \\ 4{z}^{6}(x(x+5)-3(x+5)) & = \\ 4{z}^{6}(x-3)(x+5)\end{aligned}
$$
